_comment: Wording that belongs to OrionLayer and not to MOO2 (decision 15). The REASON itself is the screen's own sentence from fallback_reason(); this file holds only the frame around it, so a translation replaces it without touching code. Work order 139 D. Work order 188 Part 1 adds the Stage 1 notice's two lines (HD EXTENSION f12_notice, core/f12notice.py): shown wherever the game's picture would otherwise appear without F12. Work order 229 B adds the frame guard's notice (HD EXTENSION frame_guard, core/frameguard.py): {screen} is filled in, the log's path follows fault_log.
prefix: OrionLayer is showing the game's own picture:
notice_waiting: The game is waiting for an answer
notice_engine: {screen}: this orion2re lacks the fixes its HD screen needs (python tools/version_check.py)
fault_what: {screen}: an error in HD's own code. The game itself is still running.
fault_action: F12: play on (and save) in the original - F12 again: try HD once more
fault_action_alone: No game is connected: close OrionLayer and start it again
